workouts.title: Tempo Pause Front Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Front Squat
3x5 @ Add your Personal Record below - Add your Personal Record below, 24x1 Tempo / RPE 8
NOTES:
- Rest 2-3 minutes between sets.
- "24x1" means that you will take :02 to descend, :04 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Hit a weight that leaves about two reps in the tank. If the prescribed weight range is too high, then lower the weights to something more appropriate for you.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.

ROWING.
500m @ Easy Pace
1:30 Rest
400m @ Predicted 2K Pace
1:00 Rest
200m @ Sprint
1:30 Rest
+
2000m Time Trial
+
Rest up to 5:00
+
500m EASY Cooldown
NOTES:
- Today, we are establishing a 2k Row PR pace that will be used every week during this program. Give your best effort and keep in mind this is to establish a number to work off of. If you don't beat your best-ever 2k that is okay... you will later.
- Keep stroke rate between 26-32 s/m
- Record your score here: Add your Personal Record below/500m
